llm_responses.reasoning:
Let me analyze the error. The error is in cell 5, which is trying to display images from the training dataset. The error message is:

```
TypeError: only integer scalar arrays can be converted to a scalar index
```

This error is occurring at the line:
```python
plt.title(class_names[labels[i]])
```

The issue is that `labels[i]` is likely not a scalar integer when using `label_mode='categorical'`. With categorical labels, the labels are one-hot encoded vectors (arrays), not scalars. So `labels[i]` would be an array like `[0, 0, 1, 0, ...]` rather than a single integer like `2`.

To fix this, we need to convert the categorical label to a class index. We can use `np.argmax(labels[i])` to get the index of the class with the highest value.

Let me fix this by changing:
```python
plt.title(class_names[labels[i]])
```
to:
```python
plt.title(class_names[np.argmax(labels[i])])
```

This will convert the one-hot encoded label to a scalar index that can be used to access the class_names list.
